name: Dreams of Reality
source:
Tragedy can bring people together or rip them apart.

A regular family, a mother with a blossoming artistic career and a daughter about to embark on the next stage of her life. And you, the father, with dreams and aspirations to become a professional DJ in the club scene. It may be simple, but life couldn’t be better, that is, until the cruel hand of fate decides to intervene and threaten that stability.

As your world is pulled away and your grip on reality is at risk, the support of family and friends will be vital to pull you through. But fate is not finished and a chance encounter with a young woman could well be your undoing, or perhaps, your hope for sanity.

Meanwhile, the sinister forces that sent your life and mind into turmoil still lurk in the shadows and endanger all you hold dear. It’s up to you to help our tortured hero conquer his demons.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cenc]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
悲剧能将人凝聚在一起，也能让彼此分崩离析。

一个普通的家庭，母亲的艺术事业正蒸蒸日上，女儿即将踏入人生的新阶段。而你，身为父亲，怀着成为俱乐部专业DJ的梦想。生活虽然简单，却已经再好不过。直到残酷的命运之手决定介入，威胁这份安稳。

当熟悉的世界被从身边夺走，现实感也摇摇欲坠时，家人与朋友的支持将成为你渡过难关的关键。然而，命运尚未罢休。与一名年轻女子的偶遇，或许会令你彻底崩溃，也或许是让你保持清醒的希望。

与此同时，将你的人生与心智搅入混乱的险恶力量仍潜伏在暗处，威胁着你珍视的一切。帮助这位饱受折磨的主角战胜内心的恶魔，就由你来决定。
